name: Financial Instrument Swap
definition: Characteristics and conditions by which a borrower can exchange one type of financial instrument for another.

ForwardSellBackFrequency.name: Forward Sell Back Frequency
ForwardSellBackFrequency.definition: Frequency at which the sold financial instrument is being returned.

ForwardBuyBackFrequency.name: Forward Buy Back Frequency
ForwardBuyBackFrequency.definition: Frequency at which the bought financial instrument is being returned.

InterestComputation.name: Interest Computation
InterestComputation.definition: Method used to compute the accrued interest of a financial instrument.

Maturity.name: Maturity
Maturity.definition: Range of time during which a swap is in effect.

SpotSell.name: Spot Sell
SpotSell.definition: Details of the spot leg of the sell-side of a swap.

SpotBuy.name: Spot Buy
SpotBuy.definition: Details of the spot leg of the buy-side of a swap.

ForwardBuyBack.name: Forward Buy Back
ForwardBuyBack.definition: Details of the forward leg of a swap that has been sold and is being returned, ie, bought back.

ForwardSellBack.name: Forward Sell Back
ForwardSellBack.definition: Details of the forward leg of a swap that has been bought and is being returned, ie, sold back.
